title: The first page of the second year
logline: The drafting table on the fifth of January with a blank sheet, the lamp, the pen, and the pup's chin on the table's edge. Box 22 open on the floor with one page in it: this one, when it's done.

panels.composition: A drafting table under the lamp with a blank sheet, a brush pen and a small three-legged dog's chin resting on the table's edge, an open cardboard box on the floor with one sheet in it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a drafting table under a lamp with a blank sheet and a brush pen and a small three-legged dog's chin resting on the table's edge, an open cardboard box on the floor holding one sheet, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
